extracted.stage: Ongoing financial remedy proceedings, hearing listed
extracted.summary: A solicitor at Aldous Solicitors LLP asks for £23,500 to fund a client's representation in ongoing financial remedy proceedings where the matrimonial pot is around £80,000 and a hearing is listed for 5 October 2026.
extracted.draft_reply: Thank you for your enquiry on behalf of your client, which we have received and logged. To progress our review we would need confirmation of the jurisdiction and court dealing with the proceedings, your client's details and identification, a breakdown of the costs the £23,500 is intended to cover, and supporting information on the assets in dispute and their current status. Details of any Form E disclosure or asset schedule, and confirmation of who controls the liquid assets, would also be helpful. Once we have those, our team will consider the enquiry and come back to you. Nothing in this message should be taken as an indication of whether funding is available or on what terms.
